Tier 12 Planner Widgets & Playground 📅

Substantial, self-contained planner widgets built with the JSON-island initial state, commit-on-action pattern. Every drag-and-drop interaction uses the Pointer Events API and features a full keyboard-accessible equivalent.

📋 Kanban Task Board & Live fx-post Payload Logger

Drag cards across columns using Pointer Events or test keyboard accessibility: Focus a card with Tab, press Space to pick up, move with ← / →, and press Enter to drop.

Live Payload Log (Mock fx-post Server Receiver)
Waiting for card movements or user commits...

📅 Interactive Calendar Widget

Month/Week/Day views reading from JSON islands, with click-to-create modals and Pointer Events date dragging.

📊 Gantt Chart & Dependency Editor

Task bars with SVG dependency arrows, drag-to-resize/reschedule, and keyboard duration adjustments.

⏱️ Resource Scheduler Grid

Resource-by-time-slot matrix for assigning staff/rooms across hourly slots.

🎨 Freeform Whiteboard Surface

Client-only HTML5 Canvas drawing & sticky-notes surface. State serializes to JSON on draw/edit.
